citations.assessment: The digital 9:8:2 confirms that Menaḥem and Guryon are brothers. It names the person before whom he explains the ruling as R. Ila. Heilprin’s shorter רבי is preserved in the main line.

evidence.witness: The Jerusalem Talmud, edition by Heinrich W. Guggenheimer. Berlin, De Gruyter, 1999-2015
